_comment: Spell NAMES (as they appear in mythicsim-forever-engine/data/spells.jsonl) that Forte_Cooldown tracks for Warlock; resolved family-scoped (Family=5, verified via signature spells: Shadow Bolt/Corruption/Create Healthstone -> 5) with the CD-carrier rank pick + companion-shadow rule + uncoded-family fallback (see tools/gen_spell_data.py docstring). Selection policy: cooldowns = castable spells whose CooldownMs/CategoryCooldownMs >= 2990 (ForteXorcist 2.99 s floor); buffs = DurationMs > 0 with no cooldown - curses/Banes, DoTs, channel windows, proc windows; shards-and-stones = Create*stone casting + stone use/apply family; demonic-utility = armor/skin toggles, CC (Banish/Fear/Subjugate Demon), pet taunt, summon rituals and portals. Re-added 2026-11-01: (a) via the uncoded-family fallback (their rows carry Family 0/absent in this build -- the stone USE spells live unflagged): Use Soulstone (-> 20761), Firestone (-> 17949), Spellstone (-> 1237159), Soul Harvest (-> 1242853; the Family-5 row 437032 is a bare companion, the uncoded row carries the 10 s window); (b) via the companion-shadow rule (the generator's rank pick now prefers the row carrying CooldownMs/DurationMs over the bare companion row whose sole Effect is ApplyAura(aura=332, points=<real id>)): Summon Felguard -> 427733 (companion 431754), Metamorphosis -> 403789 (companion 403873), Immolation Aura -> 427726 (companion 431757; lv-50 bare damage twin 427725 no longer wins), Backdraft -> 427714 (15 s proc window), Shadowflame -> 426325 (companion 426454; DoT twin 426320 at equal level loses the ID tie), Grimoire of Synergy -> 426301 (companion 426444; permanent glyph aura), Dance of the Wicked -> 412800 (lv-60 bare twin 412798 no longer wins). Pure GCD filler casts (Shadow Bolt, Searing Pain, Incinerate, Life Tap) are outside the CD/buff/stance policy and untracked. Re-check after each mythicsim-forever-engine pull; run with --dry first. Forever renames observed: Curse of Agony -> Bane of Agony, Curse of Doom -> Bane of Doom, Curse of Elements -> Curse of the Elements; Curse of Tongues/Weakness/Recklessness keep Cata names. Notable Forever-new warlock spells: Bane of Havoc, Curse of Exhaustion (lv 60), Curse of Idiocy, Shadow Cleave (AoE Shadow Bolt twin, 6 s category), Amplify Curse (now 180 s CD), Demon Charge, Demonic Howl, Demonic Grace, Demonic Brand, Decimation, Infernalist/Infernalist Armor/Infernal Armor, Vengeance, Chaos Bolt, Haunt, Wickedness, Shadow Spark, Soul Fire!, Spreading Pain, Wrack, Portal of Summoning (1 h ritual), Grimoire of Synergy, Metamorphosis, Immolation Aura, Summon Felguard (new demonology pet, lv 10). pet-abilities (added 2026-11-02, D3): the Succubus/Felhunter/Voidwalker kit that exists ONLY in the wowsims 70707 spell store (Family-5 rows with no row at all in the 70425 mythicsim pull -- docs/research/forever-data-gaps.md G6); the generator sources those rows from the 70707 overlay (tools/overrides_70707.json), e.g. Seduction 6358/6359 (20707 was the 70425-era id slot for the name), Spell Lock 19244/19647 (the pet kick, 30 s), Devour Magic 19505+ (8 s), Mesmerize 24594 (name-only in the store -- a data row, values need the live probe), Summon Imp/Succubus/Incubus/Felhunter (10 s casts, permanent). The 70425-era 'no Seduction on Forever' verdict was measured on 70425 data + the sim client (PLAN §11 correction 2026-11-02). Excluded from the kit: the Eureka! gnomish racial (family-coded per race), the 2 h Felguard passive auras (Burning Shadow, Fel Energy, Fel Stamina, Touch of Fire), the bare Effect twins (Tainted Blood Effect, Devour Magic Effect), and the family-coded non-pet line Revelation 1323392.
